AbstractText.Label: PURPOSE OF REVIEW
AbstractText.content: Vocal tremor in movement disorders is often overlooked, although it has a significant impact on quality of life. Careful observation of tremor phenomenology allows for accurate diagnosis and tailored treatment.

AbstractText.Label: RECENT FINDINGS
AbstractText.content: The central pathways associated with various vocal tremor-associated diseases have been further elucidated.

AbstractText.Label: SUMMARY
AbstractText.content: Patients are likely to benefit from a combination of medical and interventional treatments delivered within a multidisciplinary setting.
